examples.turoyo: Lad dike mqatalle (ʕam ḥḏoḏe), mgamballe ḥḏoḏe bu admo.
examples.raw: Lad dike mqatalle (ʕam ḥḏoḏe), mgamballe ḥḏoḏe bu admo. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Lak kalbe mqatalle, mgamballe ḥḏoḏe bu ṭino.
examples.raw: Lak kalbe mqatalle, mgamballe ḥḏoḏe bu ṭino. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: 6. Maḥatte bu+gubo, maḥatte bu+gubo, azzeyo w mədde i+qeməstayḏe, mədde i+qeməstayḏe, mgamblalle bayn u…bayn u+admo, bayn u+hno.
examples.translation: They threw him into a cistern, they threw him into a cistern, it passed and they took his shirt, they took his shirt, they dunked it into… into blood, into a whatsit. (Joseph Story)
examples.raw:
6. Maḥatte bu+gubo, maḥatte bu+gubo, azzeyo w mədde i+qeməstayḏe, mədde i+qeməstayḏe, mgamblalle bayn u…bayn u+admo, bayn u+hno.
They threw him into a cistern, they threw him into a cistern, it passed and they took his shirt, they took his shirt, they dunked it into… into blood, into a whatsit. (Joseph Story)

examples.turoyo: An naʕime kәmgambli ruḥayye bu ʕafro.
examples.raw: An naʕime kәmgambli ruḥayye bu ʕafro.   (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: U brozo kәmgambal ruḥe bu ṭino.
examples.raw: U brozo kәmgambal ruḥe bu ṭino.           (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: U zlam nafәl mi goro, mgambal bu admo. (İlyas p.c)
examples.translation: the man fell from the roof, he became awash in blood
examples.raw: U zlam nafәl mi goro, mgambal bu admo. (İlyas p.c) the man fell from the roof, he became awash in blood

examples.turoyo: Noše bari mini l-azzeyo, azzí ono qamayto aʕle. Ono siporči wayno, rohaṭwayno marke, mḥalaqwayno raġli l-tamhenik̇é, rohaṭwayno. Azzino ʕal riše, kal komigambal, twir qarʕe, mpalpax qarʕe, w ʕayne tavda w druʕone (219 NI 6)
